content:
Hey there! 👋 I'm **Memi**, your go-to AI agent with full system access. Here's what I can do:

### 🔧 System & Files
- Manage files/folders — read, write, move, delete, search
- Run commands & scripts (Python, Node, shell, etc.)
- System monitoring — CPU, memory, disk, processes

### 🌐 Network & Web
- Web search & fetch webpage content
- HTTP requests (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE)
- DNS lookup, ping, IP info
- Download files, open URLs in browser

### 🛠 Utilities
- Generate passwords, QR codes, UUIDs, hashes
- Encode/decode (base64, URL)
- Convert colors, parse JSON/CSV
- Compare files, count text, format data

### 📍 Location & Time
- Get your location, current time, weather
- Set timers, reminders, scheduled tasks

### 📸 Plus
- Screenshots, image info, clipboard read/write
- Git operations, zip/unzip, notifications

**Bottom line:** Tell me what you need done — I'll do it. No hand-holding required. 😎

What's your first move?
